newsitem.title: USA: Manager selects SNET as top pick-Barron's.
newsitem.headline: Manager selects SNET as top pick-Barron's.

text.p: Lee Forker Jr, a manager of a Boston investment counseling firm, told Barron's business weekly he considered Southern New England Telecommunications Corp a favorite pick and a likely takeover target.
Forker, who heads up the New England Research & Management firm, said the telephone company has a "huge advantage" in the current struggle between long-distance companies and the regional bells.

"The future is already here in their service area. They provide local phone service and cable in Hartford, and are a big factor in cellular. They are not dumb people. The fast-growing part of SNG is long distance," Forker said in a interview in the March 24 issue of Barron's.
He said the company is a likely takeover target, citing the new entity from the Nynex Corp and Bell Atlantic Corp merger as the most probable buyer.
"If it doesn't, another Baby Bell will. Since last fall, SNG has performed worse than any of the Bells. That's value," he said.
Barron's also said Forker recommended Questar Corp, Southwest Airlines Co, UST Corp, Fleetwood Enterprises Inc, and Nucor Corp.
